newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P gives counterparty ratings to Phatra.
newsitem.headline: S&P gives counterparty ratings to Phatra.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it assigned a BBB-minus long-term counterparty rating to Phatra Thanakit Public Company Ltd (Phatra).
S&P said the short-term counterparty rating of the company was A-3, adding that the rating outlook was negative.
The ratings took into account Phatra's market position and strong business franchise as one of Thailand's leading finance and securities companies, it said.
The agency also said it considered Phatra's business profile "to be less exposed to the higher risk areas of the finance and securities sectors in Thailand".
Phatra was also less exposed to the current downturn in the Thai stock market and economy as it conducted very little hire purchase business or margin lending, it said.
Its negative rating outlook, however, reflected the agency's concerns "that the economic downturn and resulting asset-quality problems will be higher and more prolonged than anticipated."
